"''It hasn't changed at all. Still delightfully secretive in all its ways.|[[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Chelli Lona Aphra]]|[[Doctor Aphra – Chaos Agent 1|''Doctor Aphra – Chaos Agent'' 1]]}} '''Daiyu City'''''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' was a [[city]] located on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[9 BBY]],{{KenobiDate|I}} [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] of the [[Inquisitorius]] devised a plan to lure [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] out of hiding by learning of his relationship with [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]]. The Third Sister had [[Vect Nokru]] and his gang [[Ambush on Alderaan|kidnap]] Organa's daughter [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]].{{Kenobi|Part I}} Kenobi traveled in Daiyu in order to [[Search for Princess Leia|rescue]] Leia.{{Kenobi|Part II}} {{City-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Daiyu City first appeared in "[[Part II]]", the second episode of the television series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']]. ==Appearances== *{{Kenobi|Part II}} {{1st}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 2|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 2]] *{{Kenobi|Part VI}} {{Flash}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 6|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 6]] {{Flash}} *[[Doctor Aphra – Chaos Agent 1|''Doctor Aphra – Chaos Agent'' 1]] *[[Legacy of Vader 7|''Legacy of Vader'' 7]] {{Flash}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Daiyu City}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Daiyu city |ka=ქალაქი დაიიუ |nl=Daiyu City }} [[Category:Cities]] [[Category:Daiyu locations]] [[Category:Galactic Empire cities]]
